description: The user-facing action completes quickly and attribution is recorded immediately.
safe_action: Accept the workflow because the user-facing response is fast and attribution evidence is completed immediately.

description: The user-facing action completes quickly while attribution is safely deferred for background recovery.
safe_action: Allow the user-facing workflow to proceed while preserving a deferred attribution record for background recovery.

scenario: Slow path caused by synchronous dependency
description: The user-facing action waits for a slow downstream dependency before completing.
safe_action: Review the workflow because the user-facing path is blocked by synchronous downstream dependency work.

description: Attribution is deferred but the workflow does not preserve enough evidence for reliable recovery.
safe_action: Block approval because attribution was deferred without sufficient audit evidence for reliable recovery.

description: A previously deferred attribution item is recovered successfully by a background process.
safe_action: Accept the workflow because deferred attribution was recovered and audit evidence remains complete.

scenario: Background recovery failed but remains retryable
description: Background recovery fails, but the deferred attribution item remains available for a later retry.
safe_action: Escalate for review because recovery failed, but keep the deferred attribution item retryable.

description: The user-facing action completes but no attribution record or recovery evidence is preserved.
safe_action: Block the workflow because attribution was lost and no deferred recovery evidence was preserved.
